text:
maya: Quick proposal for a tight PLG microexperiment next week: test whether personalized promptpacks drive deeper activation than credits alone. four arms: (1) control: no credits + generic quickstart, (2) credits-only: 50 starter credits + generic quickstart, (3) personalized-templates: no credits + 3 tailored templates based on signup use-case, (4) combo: 50 credits + personalized templates. primary metric = prompt_reuse_rate at 7d (did user call same template >=2x), secondary = time_to_first_success, tokens_used_week1, and conversion. budget cap $2k. who can own routing and tagging?

claire: love it. routing note: randomize at signup but only surface personalized template after the first successful API call so we reduce noise from signups that never use the product. can we persist assignment to user.experiments.persona_test?

rafael: i'll do routing. @growth-bot can you spin up assignment + grant logic? grant for credits arms should fire on first_success. also add email_domain whitelist for corporate addresses.

growth-bot: experiment created: id persona-2026-09-tailored-vs-credits. assignment: randomized at signup, persisted to user.attributes.experiments.persona_test. grants: credits granted on event:first_success for arms credits-only and combo. personalized template delivery: triggered on event:first_success for arms personalized-templates and combo. whitelist: email_domain not in [gmail.com,yahoo.com,outlook.com]. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/persona-2026-09

simon: analytics asks: tag every user with experiment_id and arm, capture first_success_ts, prompt_used_id list, prompt_use_count per prompt, webinar_attended boolean (we may invite later), referral_source, and initial_token_usage. i'll run prompt_reuse analysis and post a dashboard.

maya: creative: for personalized templates we'll need 3 vertical buckets (marketing, developer, ops) with 3 micro-templates each plus 2 short examples. want them short and actionable. claire can you draft the copy blurbs and one screenshot for the in-product template card? ETA Thu EOD.

claire: yep will draft and post in #marketing by Thu EOD. will include micro-variations for the in-product card.

rafael: ops constraints: per-user cap 60 credits, expire credits after 14 days, global spend cap $2k. also recommend throttling grants to 1 per user and emit grant_status. sample grant payload: ```json
{"experiment_id":"persona-2026-09","arm":"combo","credits":50,"templates":["marketing_pack_v1"],"cap_per_user":60}
```

analytics-bot: ramp plan scheduled: start with 300 randomized users Mon 09:00 UTC, monitor spend and prompt reuse. alert to #marketing-ops if spend > $450 in first 24h or if prompt_reuse_rate < 5%.

simon: small measurement note: for prompt_reuse we count repeat calls to the same prompt_id by the same user within 7 days. we'll exclude automated test accounts. also plan to run pairwise chi-square tests vs control and logistic regression controlling for referral_source and org_size.

maya: timeline: creative Thu EOD, infra + routing Fri noon, instrumentation live before launch. target launch Mon AM. assign owners: @rafael infra/routing, @simon analytics, @claire creative. please keep updates in-thread.

rafael: will implement routing and add webhook to analytics on grant/template delivery. will post a quick smoke test when ready.

claire: posting copy and template samples in #marketing in 20m. pls react with :eyes: so i can finalize.

maya: excellent. final checklist in-thread: creative by Thu EOD, routing + grant infra by Fri noon, tests green Sat, launch Mon. call blockers out asap. :rocket:
